description: Remove the recurring production scan multipliers, close long-lived read transactions, and repair the bounded agenda-11 acceptance driver without weakening scientific or resource gates.
preconditions: Owner authorized deployment and controlled acceptance on 2026-08-12.
The independent read-only observer reports PASS before deployment.
R8 shows zero active experiment runs, GPU jobs, attempt reservations, compute jobs, Colab requests, open LLM reservations, and active grants.
Actual settled token use is below the owner gate of 245452 before new LLM output resumes.
All five live targets exactly match source commit 93b1f23^; any mismatch stops deployment.
A controlled PostgreSQL custom-format backup and OPERATORS.log BEFORE DEPLOY entry are recorded before any live file is replaced.
No schema, environment, systemd unit, or manual business-table change belongs to this batch.
deployment_steps: Keep deepgraph-auto-advance.timer disabled and stop its service, then stop deepgraph-auto-execute.service, deepgraph-observe@10/11.service, and deepgraph-web.service after R8 is zero.
Apply batch 1 through scripts/deploy_manifest_batch.py and verify all five deployed SHA256 values.
Run py_compile on all five live modules.
Start web once and verify that its exact stats snapshot completes without a recurring 30-second scan; monitor disk I/O before starting any acceptance work.
Restart observers and auto-execute; keep the normal auto-advance timer disabled while one bounded --agenda 11 pass runs with --spend-limit 40000.
Observe the real preflight, grant, GPU run, artifact metrics, usage settlement, and OutcomeRecord for at most 60 minutes; stop on the owner token gate or renewed sustained high I/O.
Append every production action, backup path, checksum, restart, health result, and acceptance result to OPERATORS.log.
Do not manually mutate business state; all recycle, plan, grant, forge, execution, settlement, and OutcomeRecord transitions use deployed entry points.
tests: 42 targeted tests passed; full suite 72 failed / 830 passed / 18 skipped / 3 collection errors, with no new failures versus the 72-failure / 3-error baseline and six additional passes over source 8e7f2c3; all six meta-harness audits exit 0; independent observer reran 29 critical tests and all six audits.

rollback.order: stop services after R8 zero, then reverse batch 1
steps: Use deploy_manifest_batch.py --rollback for 1-io-scan-containment and verify all five restored predeployment SHA256 values.
No schema, .env, or systemd unit change is part of this batch, so no secondary rollback is required.
Keep the auto-advance timer disabled; restart only web, observers, and auto-execute after I/O is verified safe.
Record restored hashes, service states, health results, and any autonomous data effects in OPERATORS.log.
rollback.data_impact: The deployment itself changes only files. The controlled acceptance pass may create normal audited preflight, grant, run, settlement, and outcome records. A code rollback preserves that business history and never rewrites it manually.

batches.purpose: Prevent recurrence of the production EBS scan storm while keeping one bounded V1 acceptance path executable.
batches.health_check: Re-hash all targets, py_compile them, verify HTTP 200 and a single real stats snapshot, then confirm no recurring hidden-bridge or exact-stats scans and safe disk I/O.
batches.acceptance: Five deployed hashes equal the manifest; the timer remains disabled; the one-shot web snapshot does not recur; agenda 11 stays under the 40000 process guard and owner token gate; V1 completes only on a real GPU result and a new OutcomeRecord.
